# Tomoshi test data attribution

The abbreviated lexical excerpts in `../tomoshi-importer.integration.test.ts`
are derived from the Tomoshi open data release v2026-10-06:
https://github.com/tomoshi-app/tomoshi-dict-data/releases/tag/v2026-10-06

JMdict-derived lexical data: © Electronic Dictionary Research and Development
Group (EDRDG), used under CC BY-SA 4.0.
https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html

Chinese translations and derived additions: © Tomoshi (Y1Z), CC BY-SA 4.0.
Japanese definition excerpts originate from Japanese Wiktionary contributors,
as distributed through Tomoshi's `jpn_defs` table.

These data excerpts are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Modifications for tests: selected entries and glosses only; some definitions
are shortened; furigana arrays are replaced with empty arrays; ranking and
JLPT values, attribution placeholders, and one invalid ordinal are synthetic
test inputs. These fixtures are not a complete dictionary export.
